limits: Each source fixture binds a bounded selected chapter to its retained raw JSON file by full path and SHA-256.
Each source JSON records the complete raw envelope book/chapter/verse census; source_unit_count is selected-chapter native units, not the full raw verse count.

Every nonselected verse in each selected chapter is recorded in outside_scope; all other raw books, chapters, and verses remain outside the bounded fixture scope and are counted in raw_outside_scope_count.
The source-native:<filename> label identifies edition-local source numbering only; no formal cross-edition versification scheme is asserted.
The TEI contains only source-defined book/chapter containers and selected native verse carriers. No fabricated title page, heading, or paratext is included.
This fixture evidence does not claim human acceptance, rights clearance, publication, or deployment.
